rounds.diagnosis: The hover stage measures its clearance and centering at marker.body_center, but the marker is ~8.5 cm long, so a 'small clearance' at the body center puts the tip at or below the cup rim (nominal tip height -0.1 cm, down to ~-2.6 cm at the low end of the band) while +/-15 deg tilt is still permitted -- the stage can end with the marker already wedged part-way into the cup rather than hovering above it, and the subsequent insert no longer starts from a clean, clear approach. Re-pick the stage's point to marker.body_tip so the 'above cup.opening_center' clearance and the snug centering apply to the tip that must enter the opening.
